name: TextArea
description: Multi-line text input: an Input with three-line defaults, a multiline keyboard and vertically centred content.

theme.reason: A text area has no visual property of its own: every row (fill, border, radius, padding, text, hint, cursor, min height) is `InputTheme`'s, and the widget leg is forwarded verbatim. Adding a second theme class would duplicate those rows and let the two drift apart, so `theme` is null and the shared `InputTheme` is re-exported from text_area.dart instead.

notes: `deps.theme` is empty: the widget reads no token, class or theme file directly — `Input` resolves the surface, and the file only imports `components/input`, `primitives/form_core` and `primitives/input_features`.

The old `TextArea` extended `TextInputStatefulWidget` (a `TextField` subclass) purely to reach `expands`/`maxLines`/`minLines` through `widget.copyWith`, and carried ~80 forwarded `TextField` parameters that no caller set. The port is a 30-field wrapper over `Input`.

The drag-resize handle (`_TextAreaDragHandlePainter`, `expandableHeight`, `expandableWidth`, `initialHeight`, `initialWidth`, `min*`/`max*` sizes, `onHeightChanged`, `onWidthChanged`) is deleted: resizing is a layout decision that `minLines`/`maxLines`/`expands` already express, shadcn/ui has no such affordance, and the handle mutated width from a `MouseRegion` that only received `resizeLeftRight`/`resizeUpDown` cursors.
The old handle ignored `_height.isFinite`, so `initialWidth = double.infinity` plus `expandableWidth: true` produced `infinity` arithmetic on every pan; the wrapper has no equivalent state.
`Input`'s `minHeight` (36) is smaller than three text lines, so `EditableTextShell` grows the box with the content rather than clipping it.
`textCapitalization` defaults to `sentences` here, not `none` as in `Input`: prose fields capitalise their first letter, and `Input`'s default suits a code or number field.
